listings.name: CØNTRAST
listings.description: A lush East Austin oasis where private IR-sauna-and-plunge suites sit alongside a garden-style communal contrast area.

location.address: 1915 E Martin Luther King Jr Blvd #101, Austin, Texas, 78702

listings.name: The Ocean Lab
listings.description: A community-driven recovery hub near UT Austin stacking infrared sauna, cold plunge, float therapy, and PEMF under one roof.

listings.name: Melt Well
listings.description: A brand-new, ultra-private South Austin studio pairing infrared sauna, calibrated cold plunge, and medical-grade red light in your own suite.

listings.name: ULU Recovery & Wellness
listings.description: Bali-meets-Barton-Springs wellness studio with four private sauna-and-cold-plunge suites plus IV therapy and red light beds.

listings.name: Pure Sweat Studios
listings.description: South Lamar's only spot pairing a Sunlighten infrared cabin, cold plunge, and Epsom-salt float tank in one contrast therapy program.

listings.name: SWTHZ Belterra
listings.description: National contrast-therapy franchise offering private infrared sauna, cold plunge, and Vitamin-C shower suites in Southwest Austin.

listings.name: RESET on Third
listings.description: Billed as LA's lowest-cost contrast therapy, pairing a currented cold plunge with an infrared sauna in one private room.

listings.name: RVIVL
listings.description: Playa Vista's award-winning private-suite studio combining a full-spectrum infrared sauna with a Renu Cold Stoic ice bath and Aesop showers.

listings.name: Nordic Nirvana
listings.description: Norse-inspired boutique on the Cahuenga Pass with four themed private suites pairing traditional or infrared sauna with cold immersion.

listings.name: Club Contrast
listings.description: A communal Nordic sauna-and-plunge social club in Sherman Oaks built for ritual, not rush hour.

listings.name: Remedy Place West Hollywood
listings.description: The original Social Wellness Club on Sunset Strip, mixing guided ice baths and infrared sauna with IV drips, HBOT, and acupuncture.

listings.name: Sweatheory Hollywood
listings.description: Cedar-built infrared sauna pods with private showers on the Sunset/Cahuenga corner, plus cold plunge and infrared yoga classes.

location.address: 1503 N Cahuenga Blvd, Los Angeles, California, 90028

listings.name: Pause Studio Brentwood
listings.description: West LA's guided contrast therapy suite near Brentwood Country Mart, alternating infrared sauna and cold plunge on your schedule.

listings.name: Lore Bathing Club
listings.description: A phone-free NoHo bathing club offering a Finnish sauna, infrared sauna, and generous cold plunge in one unhurried 75-minute session.

listings.name: Othership Flatiron
listings.description: A 7,000-square-foot social sauna-and-ice-bath temple near Madison Square Garden built around guided breathwork classes.

listings.name: Elahni Speakeasy
listings.description: New York's first wellness speakeasy: an intimate four-person Finnish sauna and 39-degree ice bath ritual run by its founders.

listings.name: Recoverie
listings.description: A locally owned Brooklyn Bridge Park recovery club pairing dry sauna and ice bath with cryotherapy, red light, and IV drips.

listings.name: Bathhouse Flatiron
listings.description: A six-thermal-pool Manhattan bathhouse with dueling hot and cold pools plus Aufguss-guided dry sauna sessions.

listings.name: Continuum
listings.description: An AI-driven, ultra-premium West Village wellness club tracking wearables through cold plunge pools, Finnish sauna, and hyperbaric therapy.

listings.name: 24 Hour Fitness
listings.description: A big-box gym whose sauna has a genuine following — and a wellness area with documented maintenance problems, including past pool closures and mold complaints in reviews. The training floor is huge and the staff earn consistent praise, so the sauna's upkeep is the variable. Despite the name, this location no longer runs 24 hours.

listings.name: 360 Tans
listings.description: Primarily an airbrush tanning studio — 50-plus shades, eco-certified DHA solutions — that also lists infrared and red light services. It holds a 4.9 rating across nearly 700 reviews, with technicians praised by name for putting first-timers at ease. Come for the tan; treat the light therapy as the add-on.

location.address: 6203 N Capital of Texas Hwy Ste 350, Austin, Texas, 78731

listings.name: Bathe
listings.description: Austin's first bathhouse runs three distinct saunas, cold plunges at varied temperatures, a dipping pool, and a magnesium-enriched barrel soaking tub — with coworking space by day and private events after hours. Day passes and memberships both available.

location.address: 2922 E Cesar Chavez St, Austin, Texas, 78702

listings.name: Bouldering Project - Springdale
listings.description: Austin's big climbing gym hides a real contrast setup in the locker rooms: sauna plus cold plunge, included with a day pass or membership. Reviewers love the facilities but flag sauna etiquette — phones, skipped showers — as a recurring annoyance. Rated 4.8 across 1,866 reviews.

listings.name: Ceremony
listings.description: A plant-filled indoor-outdoor bathhouse with two cedar saunas, including a newer Finnish build, and cold plunges kept below 45°F. The $200 ten-pack is widely considered strong value, though reviewers flag confusing rules around group passes. Massage therapists on staff earn name-drops in reviews.

listings.name: Cold Plunge Austin
listings.description: A dedicated plunge-and-sauna shop built around private rooms: two infrared sauna suites with red light therapy (the Lava Room and Jungle Room) and two private plunge rooms held at 43°F. Walk-ins are accepted, though appointments are recommended.

listings.name: Dell JCC
listings.description: The sauna at the Dell JCC comes bundled with a community-center membership — fitness floor, classes, and pools included. It holds a 4.2 rating across 101 reviews. Best suited to members who want heat as one part of a broader routine, not a dedicated spa visit.

listings.name: East Communities YMCA
listings.description: A no-frills sauna inside the East Communities YMCA, where access folds into a standard Y membership. That makes it one of the cheapest ways to get regular heat exposure in Austin — expect functional facilities rather than spa polish.

listings.name: EvolvE
listings.description: A recovery studio whose signature trio stacks compression therapy, infrared sauna, and a cryotherapy chamber — regulars describe spending hours cycling through all three. Staff earn unusually personal praise, from the front desk tours to the practitioners. Membership is the best-value route if you go weekly.

listings.name: F45 Training Hilton Downtown
listings.description: This downtown F45 pairs its 45-minute functional training classes with a sauna for post-workout heat. Rated 4.9 across 49 reviews. A practical pick if you already train downtown; less compelling as a standalone sauna destination.

listings.name: Fitness Connection
listings.description: A 50,000-square-foot budget gym whose sauna members describe as 'heaven,' alongside women's-only workout zones, basketball courts, and a Kids' Club. Rated 4.4 across 2,332 reviews. The sauna rides along with a standard gym membership, making it one of the cheaper heat options in Austin.

listings.name: Generator Athlete Lab
listings.description: Structured 60-minute recovery sessions move you through infrared sauna, cold plunge, Normatec compression, vibration plates, and red light therapy with staff guidance. It holds a perfect 5.0 across 231 reviews. Built for athletes who want a protocol to follow, not just open access.

location.address: 800 W Cesar Chavez St PP120, Austin, Texas, 78701

listings.name: HOTWORX - Austin, TX - Lakeline
listings.description: A 24-hour infrared fitness studio where the workout happens inside the sauna: virtually instructed HIIT, Hot Pilates, Hot Yoga, and Hot Cycle sessions. App-based entry, consistently clean studios, 4.7 across 114 reviews. One caution: multiple reviewers report frustration with the membership cancellation process.

listings.name: Jacoby Plunges
listings.description: Founder-led cold exposure sessions built around a 1 HP chiller that pulls the water down to 37°F, with coaching aimed at getting newcomers past the mental barrier. The community — retreats, breathwork events, visiting wellness practitioners — is as much the draw as the plunge itself. Rated 5.0 across 29 reviews.

listings.name: Korrect Fitness
listings.description: One of the few Austin gyms with both a traditional sauna and a cold plunge on site, so members can run genuine contrast rounds between lifts. The 4.9 rating across 321 reviews is unusually strong for a gym recovery corner. Access comes with a gym membership.

listings.name: Northwest YMCA of Austin
listings.description: The Northwest YMCA's sauna is a membership perk rather than a destination — basic, communal, and covered by your Y dues. Worth knowing about if you live nearby; not a reason to join on its own.

listings.name: Öli Saunas
listings.description: Öli isn't a studio but a local builder: home saunas in Thermo-Spruce and Western Cedar, Huum heaters, and cold plunges, sold through an Austin showroom with design consults and code-compliant installation. Reviewers praise the no-pressure process and responsive after-sale support. The place to compare craft before buying from a faceless online retailer.

listings.name: Organic Bronze Spray Tanning - Airbrush Tanning Austin
listings.description: A Domain-area airbrush tanning salon with red light therapy on the service menu. Technicians are named in reviews for patient first-timer walkthroughs, and the 4.6 rating spans 177 reviews. Recurring complaints mention wait times and a membership-credit policy some guests find misleading.

listings.name: Palm Beach Tan
listings.description: Mostly a tanning salon — UV beds, spray tans, red light facials, massage chairs — with a full-spectrum sauna rounding out the menu. Rated 4.5 across 139 reviews, with staff product knowledge a frequent highlight. Cancellation complaints are the recurring negative theme.

location.address: 4815 W Braker Ln Ste 520, Austin, Texas, 78759

listings.name: Perspire Sauna Studio
listings.description: Private full-spectrum infrared sauna suites, each with its own temperature panel, color light therapy, TV, and Bluetooth speakers, finished with a cooling eucalyptus towel. Two things to know before booking: there is no cold plunge, and showers are members-only. Rooms are repeatedly described as spotless.

location.address: 4404 W William Cannon Dr Suite C, Austin, Texas, 78749

listings.name: Restore Hyper Wellness
listings.description: The Mueller outpost of the national recovery chain pairs cryotherapy and infrared sauna with IV drips, NAD+, compression, and red light therapy. Rated 4.9 across 324 reviews, with no membership pressure and FSA funds accepted. A minority of reviewers dislike the scent of the cleaning products used on site.

listings.name: S W E A T L A N D
listings.description: An infrared-only studio with a genuine twist: lay-down SUITE saunas that keep your head outside the heat, plus upright CABANA options and a full-body red light room. You control the temperature and the music; cold towels and electrolytes are included. Note there is no cold plunge here.

listings.name: Sage Blossom Massage
listings.description: A massage studio first — therapists are praised by name across 752 reviews for intuitive, unhurried work — with infrared sauna sessions available alongside. Rated 4.9. Book it as massage with sauna time rather than expecting a bathhouse experience.

listings.name: Southwest Family YMCA
listings.description: Southwest Austin's family Y keeps a traditional sauna in the locker room wing. This is the budget play: heat access folded into a family membership, with the expected trade-offs of shared space and busy evenings.

listings.name: SWEATCITY Mobile Health and Recovery
listings.description: SWEATCITY flips the model — it's a mobile outfit, so the sauna and cold plunge come to your home, gym, or event rather than the other way around. No storefront to visit; you book the rig and they set it up.

listings.name: Townlake YMCA
listings.description: Austin's flagship Y on Town Lake includes a traditional sauna among its amenities. Membership also covers one of the better-located gym floors in the city, with the hike-and-bike trail right outside the door.

location.address: 1100 W Cesar Chavez St, Austin, Texas, 78703

listings.name: True REST Float Spa • Austin North
listings.description: A float-first spa — pods holding over 1,000 pounds of dissolved Epsom salt at skin temperature — that begins sessions with a sauna-and-ice-bath contrast round. Tea bar, oxygen bar, and prep rooms on site. Most reviews glow, though a few mention occasional pod cleanliness lapses.

location.address: 10721 Research Blvd Suite B-170, Austin, Texas, 78759

listings.name: YTX - YTX Yoga, Strength, Pilates, & HIIT Training
listings.description: YTX is a yoga, strength, Pilates, and HIIT studio first — the infrared sauna is the recovery bonus members use after class. The workouts carry a 4.7 rating across 437 reviews. Treat the sauna as a strong perk rather than the main event.

listings.name: America's Steam, Sauna & Spas
listings.description: Cold Plunge & SaunaThis spa specializes in the expert repair, maintenance, and installation of residential steam saunas and steam showers. Spa-goers report that their technicians provide essential service to ensure these units function at their peak, with one guest noting their steam generator had "never ever worked remotely to how amazing it’s working now" after a professional adjustment. The service encompasses troubleshooting, repairing, and rebuilding units from brands like Amerec and Mr. Steam, with technicians offering valuable maintenance tips to extend the life and enjoyment of the equipment. The focus is on restoring the quality of the in-home sauna and steam experience, which is particularly appreciated during colder months.StaffThe spa is a family-run business with a team of knowledgeable and personable technicians. Guests frequently mention staff members by name, including Martha and Nancy in the office for patient scheduling, and technicians Jim and Alex. Spa-goers describe Jim as honest and easy to talk to, providing clear options without pressure. Alex is noted for being extremely informative, explaining repairs in detail and offering helpful maintenance tips. The staff's expertise in steam, sauna, and whirlpool systems is consistently highlighted as a cornerstone of the service.PricingGuests consistently describe the service as offering good value, with reasonable and competitive pricing. The spa provides honest consultations where Jim spells out options without a hard sell, allowing guests to make informed decisions. The value for the price is described by one guest as "out of this world," leading many to state they will not use anyone else for their steam sauna maintenance needs.

listings.name: BIÂN | A Luxury Private Club
listings.description: BIÂN is a luxury private club where the state-of-the-art steam rooms with integrated cold plunge pools are a standout amenity. Gym members specifically highlight the cold plunge within the steam room, creating an accessible contrast therapy experience. The venue also offers an infrared sauna, which is noted as a beneficial feature, and cryotherapy sessions are available. The overall sauna and cold plunge facilities contribute to a comprehensive recovery and wellness regimen within the club's ecosystem.Beyond thermal therapies, this gym provides over 20 daily studio and fitness classes with trainers described as excellent and magical at targeting specific needs. The full-service spa includes luxury massage therapy and body treatments, with particular praise for the massage services. Members enjoy access to spa-inspired locker rooms, an open gym, and approximately 10,000 square feet of co-working space. The venue features a restaurant and bar serving nourishing food, including smoothies, bowls, and light meals that members find revitalizing. Additional wellness services include guided meditation sessions and IV treatments. The design creates a soothing and chic atmosphere with a chill vibe, fostering a wellness-minded community. Membership includes extensive social and educational events, positioning the club as a one-stop destination for health, work, and social networking.

location.address: 600 W Chicago Ave Suite 001, Chicago, Illinois, 60654

listings.name: Bijou Body Spa
listings.description: Cold Plunge & SaunaThis spa offers a premier wellness experience centered on its highly effective infrared sauna. Spa-goers consistently praise the infrared sauna for its therapeutic benefits, noting it works wonders for relaxation and physical recovery. Guests specifically highlight how the sauna helps relieve tense muscles, promotes calorie burning, and provides a deeply relaxing heat therapy experience. The sauna facilities are described as exceptionally clean and functional, contributing to a high-quality session.AtmosphereThe establishment is described as clean, beautiful, and functional, with a calming and soothing atmosphere. Guests note the spa is always welcoming and well-organized, with a pleasant scent upon entry. The overall environment contributes to a serene and tranquil experience for visitors.StaffThe spa is led by owner Trina (LaTrina), who is consistently praised as compassionate, knowledgeable, and professional. Guests describe her as a nurse who helps heal and uplift people, providing great advice and making them feel comfortable. Her assistant Trinity and the receptionist are also noted for being kind, patient, professional, and very knowledgeable, taking time to answer questions and provide clear instructions.Additional AmenitiesBeyond the core sauna, the spa offers cellulite reduction treatments. Guests report positive results from these services, noting feelings of tighter skin and smoothness after a series of sessions. The owner provides honest evaluations and recommends the right service for each guest's needs.

listings.name: Biolife Organic Spa
listings.description: StaffSpa-goers consistently praise the specialized expertise of the staff, particularly owner Ewa, who possesses an impressive understanding of skincare and uses the highest quality technology and products. Guests also highlight the skill of technicians like Anna and Jolanta, noting their thorough, attentive, and professional approach. The team is credited with providing personalized treatment plans and recommendations that lead to significant, long-term improvements in skin health.AtmosphereThe spa offers a beautiful, serene, and clean atmosphere. Guests describe the environment as lovely, tranquil, and cozy, contributing to a relaxing and pampering experience. The facility is noted for its cleanliness and cute interior, which enhances the overall sense of calm and well-being.Additional AmenitiesThis premier organic skin care destination provides a wide range of advanced treatments. Guests report excellent results from services including microdermabrasion, dermaplaning, microneedling, and laser hair removal at reasonable prices. The spa also offers lash lifts and tints, eyebrow services, and facials using high-quality products, including Ewa's own skincare line. These treatments are designed to provide a sense of renewal, rejuvenation, and confidence.Location & ExpansionLocated at 2753 N Ashland Ave in Chicago, the spa has recently expanded with more space and additional services. This growth allows the venue to offer an enhanced range of treatments within its serene setting.

listings.name: CHICAGO BATH HOUSE
listings.description: Cold Plunge & SaunaThis spa offers a traditional bathhouse experience centered on exceptionally hot saunas and a cold plunge. Spa-goers describe the traditional sauna as extremely hot, with temperatures noted between 228°F and 242°F, which some find remarkably intense. The steam room is also described as very hot and enjoyable. A key feature is the large, well-maintained cold plunge pool, described as being ice-cold, providing a stark contrast for those practicing contrast therapy. Guests appreciate the availability of these core thermal facilities for a cleansing and relaxing experience.PricingThe venue charges an admission fee for access to all communal facilities, which include the locker rooms, sauna, jacuzzi, cold pool, and steam room. This fee is in addition to any booked services. Some guests feel this fee is steep and not clearly communicated upfront during the booking process.StaffFeedback on staff is mixed. Some guests describe encounters with reception and service staff as hostile, gruff, or rude. Specific service providers, such as a massage therapist named Gina, are cited for providing poor, amateurish service. However, other guests note that staff can be helpful and nice, with the bartender frequently mentioned as a friendly presence.Additional AmenitiesThe venue includes a full-service restaurant and bar with a menu of Russian classics like borscht, pickled vegetables, and cheese blintzes. A private room in the restaurant area is available for an additional reservation fee. The locker rooms provide robes, towels, and shower shoes, though some guests find them to be small and crowded.

listings.name: Chicago CryoSpa
listings.description: Cold Plunge & SaunaThis spa offers a standout infrared sauna that many spa-goers describe as a personal favorite. Guests frequently combine the infrared sauna with other services for a comprehensive recovery experience, noting that sessions leave them feeling deeply relaxed and with noticeably improved skin. The spa specializes in cryotherapy, providing what it describes as the coldest cryotherapy chamber in Chicago. Many guests report immediate and effective recovery benefits from the whole-body cryotherapy, especially for sore muscles and specific injuries, with the standard session lasting three minutes to achieve full benefits. The contrast between the extreme cold of cryotherapy and the deep heat of the infrared sauna is a popular combination for guests seeking post-workout recovery or relief from personal injuries.StaffThe staff receives consistent praise for being exceptionally friendly, knowledgeable, and accommodating. Specific team members like Ann, Sampson, Racie, Kendall, and Mel are highlighted for making guests feel comfortable, thoroughly explaining procedures and benefits, and providing personalized care. Spa-goers appreciate that the staff suggests treatments aligned with individual wellness goals without being pushy.Additional AmenitiesBeyond cryotherapy and the infrared sauna, the spa provides a range of regenerative services. These include red light therapy (also called LED or green light therapy), a Neo light bed, cryo-facials, local cryotherapy, Cryo T-Shock, and massage therapy. The massage services, particularly myofascial and sound vibration therapy sessions with Racie, are noted by some guests as being exceptionally effective. The facility also provides comfortable amenities like robes, socks, and slippers.AtmosphereGuests describe a welcoming, clean, and modern facility that fosters a relaxed and comfortable atmosphere. The spa is noted for its state-of-the-art equipment and overall positive environment where visitors feel pampered and able to focus on their wellness journey.

listings.name: Chicago Internal Cleansing
listings.description: Cold Plunge & SaunaChicago Internal Cleansing offers Ozone Sauna Therapy and Far Infrared Sweat Beds as central components of its wellness services. Guests specifically utilize the oxygen hydro sauna and infrared bed for detoxification and overall well-being. These heat-based therapies are noted for contributing to a deeper, longer sleep and a more centered, lighter feeling in the body. Guests report feeling great after these sessions, which are integrated into comprehensive cleansing treatments. The venue does not offer a cold plunge or contrast therapy, focusing instead on these specific heat modalities.AtmosphereThe facility is described as very clean, well-maintained, and super cozy. It maintains a calming atmosphere that helps put guests at ease. The environment is designed to provide privacy during treatments, contributing to a comfortable experience.StaffThe staff receives mixed feedback. Many guests find the team to be extremely professional, welcoming, knowledgeable, and genuinely caring. Specific therapists like Edita and Kimberly are mentioned by name for being friendly, helpful, and making guests feel comfortable. However, some guests report issues with communication, last-minute appointment changes, and feeling ignored at the front desk.Additional AmenitiesThe primary services extend beyond sauna therapy to include colonic hydrotherapy. The venue offers both traditional colonic sessions and the Libbe colonic system, which provides a self-administered approach that some guests prefer for its sense of control.

location.address: 1 E Erie St Suite 510, Chicago, Illinois, 60611

listings.name: Chicago Wellness Club
listings.description:
Cold Plunge & SaunaThis spa offers a premier infrared sauna experience that spa-goers consistently describe as deeply relaxing and beneficial for comprehensive wellness. The infrared sauna is a central feature, noted for its impeccably clean facilities and serene environment. Guests appreciate the high-end, tranquil space dedicated to this heat therapy, which forms a core part of the relaxation and recovery offerings. The sauna experience is frequently paired with float therapy sessions, with many guests opting to start with the sauna before entering the float tank.AtmosphereThe spa's atmosphere is consistently highlighted as a serene and perfectly tranquil environment, which is especially impressive given its location in the noisy center of Old Town. Guests describe it as a super chill, clean, and high-end relaxation epicenter. The relaxation room features cozy touches like a fireplace, super comfy chairs, and complimentary tea and water, providing a space to melt and reflect after services.StaffThe staff is noted for being incredibly friendly, knowledgeable, and welcoming, making guests feel taken care of. The owner, Ryan, is specifically mentioned for being incredibly kind, deeply caring about wellness, and going out of his way to promote a positive experience. Staff are also interested in guest feedback, often asking about experiences after a session.Additional AmenitiesBeyond the infrared sauna, the spa provides float therapy in private rooms that each include a shower. The float tanks offer a customizable experience with adjustable lighting and music. listings.name: Chuan Spa at The Langham, Chicago
listings.description: Chuan Spa at The Langham, Chicago provides a comprehensive thermal experience centered on its multiple sauna facilities. Spa-goers consistently note the properly hot temperatures of both the saunas and steam room, which meet expectations for an effective heat session. The venue offers a herbal sauna, a dry sauna, and a Himalayan salt room, providing variety for guests. These amenities are part of a dedicated wet and dry sauna area that guests can use before treatments. The spa also features a relaxation lounge with heated loungers for post-sauna recovery. While the reviews contain no mention of a cold plunge or contrast therapy, the thermal amenities are a highlighted feature of the experience.This award-winning spa occupies an entire floor and emphasizes traditional Chinese medicine, offering over 40 treatments including acupuncture and moxibustion. The spa experience often includes a multi-step journey. Guests frequently praise the high-quality customized massages and facials, with specific therapists like Leslie and Christine receiving notable acclaim for their skill. The beautiful, clean, and tranquil atmosphere is a major draw, complemented by amenities such as an indoor pool and hot tub. The venue is considered a premium destination for special occasions, though some guests note challenges with booking communication and occasional inconsistencies in service and cleanliness standards at the front desk and with robes.

listings.name: Contrast Hot + Cold
listings.description: Cold Plunge & SaunaThis spa offers Chicago's first communal hot and cold therapy studio, providing an effective contrast therapy experience. The venue features several large infrared saunas and dedicated cold plunge tubs in its main community space. Spa-goers frequently highlight the quality of the sauna and cold plunge, noting the sauna is perfectly relaxing and the cold plunge is super refreshing. The infrared saunas are also noted to include red light therapy. Guests can choose between the open community area or private rooms equipped with 1-2 person infrared saunas and cold plunges for a more personal session. The contrast therapy is praised for its recovery benefits, helping with inflammation, muscle soreness, and overall performance for athletes and those with physical soreness.AtmosphereThe facility is described as absolutely beautiful, well-designed, and having a great vibe. The overall environment is considered perfect for recovery and relaxation.StaffThe staff is consistently noted as friendly, knowledgeable, supportive, and welcoming. Specific owners and team members, including Braxton, Doug, and Brad, are mentioned by name for being helpful, coaching guests through best practices, and ensuring visitors get the most out of each session.Additional AmenitiesThe primary amenities focus on the contrast therapy experience. listings.name: Copper Wellness
listings.description: Copper Wellness is a premier holistic wellness center in Chicago that combines modern techniques with time-honored practices. The spa provides a personalized and integrative approach to health and well-being through a team of integrative medicine doctors and experienced medical practitioners. Guests consistently describe the environment as calming, welcoming, and filled with positive energy, with specific appreciation for details like the candles in the lobby.Spa-goers report transformative wellness experiences, particularly through acupuncture treatments provided by Dr. Stephanie Madden and Dr. Mohr. The practice also offers therapeutic massage, with Benicia noted as one of the best massage therapists. The overall experience is described as leaving guests feeling more balanced and cared for, though some guests have reported issues with billing transparency, delayed insurance claims, and customer service related to these matters.

This has led to a mixed perception of the overall customer experience, where the product quality is highly regarded but support reliability is a concern for some visitors.

listings.name: Perspire Sauna Studio
listings.description: Cold Plunge & SaunaPerspire Sauna Studio offers private, full-spectrum infrared sauna suites. Members consistently describe the saunas as impeccably clean, high-quality, and providing a very relaxing experience. The heat quality and general ambiance are frequently highlighted as major benefits. Guests appreciate the built-in red light therapy panels within the sauna. A chilled towel is provided as a refreshing amenity. The studio does not offer a cold plunge or cold shower for contrast therapy, and some members note a policy that does not allow consecutive sauna sessions.AtmosphereThe studio is described as having impeccably clean, sanitized, and welcoming spaces with immaculate vibes. Members find the ambiance to be great and the overall environment relaxing. The private suites are noted for being clean and comfortable, contributing to a tranquil experience.PricingThe studio offers memberships and an introductory session for $20. Booking is handled through an easy-to-use app. Some feedback from members indicates experiences with billing and membership cancellation can vary, with some reporting smooth processes and others reporting issues with duplicate charges or refund refusals after cancellation deadlines.StaffStaff members are frequently described as super friendly, knowledgeable, supportive, and accommodating. Specific team members, such as Emily, are highlighted for going above and beyond, being professional, and making guests feel valued by remembering names. However, other feedback points to mixed experiences with management regarding customer service and billing resolution.Additional AmenitiesThe private infrared sauna suites feature integrated speakers, allowing guests to watch shows or listen to music during their session. Some suites include private showers stocked with body wash, shampoo, and conditioner, while other suites do not have this amenity.

listings.name: Reiki Klubhouse Holistic Healing Sanctuary & Spa
listings.description: AtmosphereThe Reiki Klubhouse Holistic Healing Sanctuary & Spa offers a unique relaxation experience where time seems to dissolve in a beautiful, healing atmosphere. Guests consistently describe a warm, aroma-filled space filled with love and kindness, facilitating profound spiritual and energetic healing. The sanctuary provides a serene environment where spa-goers often leave feeling completely transformed, lighter, and better than when they arrived.StaffThe experience is centered on practitioner Mahogani Phreedom, whom guests describe as having a calming, pure-hearted presence that eases anxiety. Spa-goers note her deep intuition, honesty, and natural care, which creates a powerful and trusting energy exchange. Her extensive knowledge, spiritual connection, and generous sharing of her gift are highlighted as the core of the transformative sessions offered.Additional AmenitiesThis sanctuary provides exclusive massages, rituals, and hydrotherapy baths. Specific services praised by guests include Holistic Therapy Massage, Reiki sessions for chakra unblocking, Yoni steam release for womb healing, and Chakra Analysis. The spa also offers a range of products for purchase, such as lavender sage, crown oil for hair growth, and specialty teas, which visitors can take home.

listings.name: Restore Hyper Wellness
listings.description: Cold Plunge & SaunaThis spa offers infrared sauna sessions that guests consistently praise for their comfortable and effective heat. Spa-goers describe the temperature as being "just right," providing a deeply relaxing and refreshing experience that leaves muscles feeling looser and minds clearer, often contributing to improved sleep. The sauna facilities are noted for their cleanliness. For cold therapy, the venue provides cryotherapy, which guests use for quicker recovery and to avoid muscle soreness after activities like running. The combination of these heat and cold modalities supports a contrast therapy approach to wellness and recovery.StaffThe staff receives frequent acclaim for being kind, knowledgeable, attentive, and professional. Specific team members mentioned by name include Akeelah, Aiste, Nicole, and General Manager Carol, who leads the team. Guests appreciate that the staff is both informative and respectful of their relaxation time, creating a supportive and passionate environment for healing.Additional AmenitiesBeyond the sauna and cryotherapy, this wellness center integrates multiple modalities. Popular services include red light therapy, often combined with facials or sauna sessions, and compression therapy, which guests note has helped with pain management. The venue also offers IV therapy, which can be paired with compression. For post-treatment care, the spa provides comfortable, fully-stocked shower spaces with quality shampoo and conditioner.Location & ExpansionRestore Hyper Wellness operates multiple locations, with guests mentioning visits to spots in Hilton Head and Austin, Texas. The Lincoln Park location in Chicago caters to both local members and visitors from other cities, indicating a growing national presence in the wellness community.

listings.name: Spa InterContinental Chicago
listings.description: Cold Plunge & SaunaThis three-level spa facility offers two Finnish hot saunas. The saunas are a noted feature of the venue, located within the locker rooms. Spa-goers report significant inconsistencies with the cleanliness and maintenance of these amenities. The locker rooms housing the saunas have been described as unkept, with specific mentions of broken lockers and, in one instance, a cockroach present in the change room. The spa also provides access to a junior-size Olympic swimming pool as part of its hotel amenities, which some guests appreciate using after their services.StaffFeedback on staff is mixed. Some spa-goers describe the massage therapists as really nice, friendly, and professional, with customer service noted as very good, accommodating, and impeccable. Other guests report negative experiences, including an inexperienced massage therapist who used cold oil and provided an aggressive, painful massage that left them feeling bruised. There are also reports of poor customer service, such as no staff at the front desk to welcome guests, booking errors that were not apologized for, and significant difficulty contacting the spa by phone.Additional AmenitiesBeyond the sauna and pool, the spa offers facial and massage services. Some guests find the facials delightful, with positive results for their skin. However, the location for facial services within the women's locker room is noted as awkward, especially for male guests, and can be disrupted by noise from others in the locker room. The overall facility receives mixed feedback on cleanliness; some guests find it clean and comfortable, while others highlight unclean conditions and maintenance issues.

listings.name: SpaSpace Chicago
listings.description: Cold Plunge & SaunaSpaSpace Chicago offers a satisfying sauna experience that guests specifically seek out for relaxation and recovery. The spa provides contrast therapy and infrared sauna services as part of its core wellness offerings. Guests note the sauna was exactly what they needed, highlighting its role in post-massage recovery and overall relaxation.AtmosphereThe spa maintains a calming and relaxing atmosphere. Guests describe the environment as serene, contributing to a feeling of being refreshed and cared for. This tranquil setting is a key component of the wellness and social connection destination on the west edge of Chicago’s Loop.StaffFeedback on staff is mixed, with many spa-goers praising the professional and welcoming team. Specific massage therapists like Michael, Katrina, and Javier receive high praise for their amazing, knowledgeable, and skilled work. However, some guests report experiences with staff who were unaccommodating to specific requests or booking changes, which impacted their comfort.Additional AmenitiesBeyond core treatments, the spa provides thoughtful amenities to enhance the experience. Guests appreciate that essentials are provided both before and after appointments. A particularly noted touch is the serving of relaxing tea post-service, which adds to the overall feeling of being pampered.

listings.name: The CryoBar
listings.description: The CryoBar is a wellness studio in Chicago, IL, offering infrared sauna. The studio provides heat therapy sessions for relaxation, detoxification, and cardiovascular health. Rated 4.8 with 155 reviews. Book a session or learn more through their ContrastMap listing.

listings.name: The Earth | Reflexology • Spa
listings.description: Cold Plunge & SaunaThis spa does not feature a sauna or cold plunge facility. The wellness experience is centered on massage and reflexology services.AtmosphereThe Earth | Reflexology • Spa presents itself as a fusion-style venue aiming to provide a unique, creative, and multi-sensory "Heaven on Earth" experience. Guests note the facilities are clean and fresh. However, some spa-goers report that the actual experience can differ from the advertised diversity and free add-ons mentioned on the website.PricingPricing for massage services generates mixed feedback. The standard house fee is noted as $80 for an hour, which some guests find slightly higher than the local norm. Specific practitioners like Bob, Coco, and Lisa receive praise for good massage technique and being helpful and caring. A specific incident involving inappropriate conduct with a male guest was also reported.Additional AmenitiesThe primary additional amenity noted is a table shower, which guests find very relaxing when offered before a massage.

listings.name: Thunder Domes - Custom Sauna Builders
listings.description: Cold Plunge & SaunaThunder Domes specializes in the construction and installation of custom cedar saunas. The company's core offering is a mobile, wood-fired cedar sauna located at North Ave Beach in Chicago, providing a space for heat therapy and relaxation. Spa-goers consistently highlight the quality of the sauna product, with specific praise for its American-made craftsmanship. listings.name: 24 Hour Fitness
listings.description: The sauna and steam room at this big-box gym come with a standard membership — but read recent reviews before counting on the wet area, which draws recurring complaints about hot tub cleanliness and out-of-order equipment. Weekday 24-hour access and a huge training floor are the real draws. Rated 3.7 across 911 reviews.

listings.name: 5 Star Salt Caves Wellness Center
listings.description: Private infrared sauna rooms preset to 150°F with color light therapy — note the temperature isn't adjustable, and there's no cold plunge on site. The signature attraction is the salt cave itself, where guests stretch out on salt crystals in dim light. Massage therapists here are praised by name. Rated 4.7 across 331 reviews.

listings.name: Airie Apartments
listings.description: A residential complex that lists a traditional sauna among its amenities — though residents consistently report it has never actually been operational. Treat it as an apartment listing rather than a usable sauna option. Access to the off-site Tava gym is the more reliable perk.

listings.name: Aria Integrative Health
listings.description: Full-spectrum infrared sauna sessions share the menu with red light therapy, laser treatments, and the EXOMIND mental wellness system at this med-spa style clinic. Owner Nick and team get repeated credit for building personalized treatment plans rather than selling one-off sessions. Rated 4.7 across 213 reviews.

listings.name: Atwood Therapeutics
listings.description: A RiNo massage studio with a private sauna and cold plunge downstairs, so you can run contrast rounds before or after bodywork. Therapists Shadé, Nolan, and Jonah are named in reviews for tailoring sessions to specific pain points. Perfect 5.0 across 41 reviews.

listings.name: beem® Light Sauna - RiNo
listings.description: Bigger than the usual single-person pods, beem's social-style infrared rooms end with an optional cold shower for a DIY contrast finish. Cooling mint towels and red light beds round out the visit, and guests keep using the word 'spotless.' Rated 5.0 across 46 reviews.

listings.name: Beyond Body Sculpting
listings.description: Owner Jackie builds treatments around the dry sauna: it follows the castor oil wrap in the signature Cleopatra Detox & Sculpt ritual, and regulars pair it with lymphatic drainage massage. A small, appointment-driven studio — 5.0 across 15 reviews.

location.address: 5777 E Evans Ave Ste 5, Denver, Colorado, 80222

listings.name: Chuze Fitness
listings.description: Infrared sauna plus steam room for the price of a budget gym membership — that's the Chuze proposition in Goldsmith. The wet area is well-kept off-peak but turns into a social scene during rush hours. Rated 4.3 across 1,263 reviews.

location.address: 2253 S Monaco St Pkwy, Denver, Colorado, 80222

listings.name: Colorado Athletic Club Monaco
listings.description: Gender-specific saunas and steam rooms anchor each locker room of this sprawling 1960s athletic club, which also runs a full tennis program. The building shows its age, but the locker rooms are consistently called spotless. Rated 3.5 across 129 reviews.

location.address: 2695 S Monaco St Pkwy, Denver, Colorado, 80222

listings.name: Colorado Athletic Club Tabor Center/16th Street
listings.description: Downtown's 16th Street Mall location with a dry sauna and steam room members describe as clean and well-maintained — though the hot tub and the cancellation process both draw fire. Expect $100-plus monthly dues plus parking. Rated 3.6 across 251 reviews.

listings.name: Denver Mobile Sauna
listings.description: The sauna comes to you: a cabin-style mobile unit with a bubble window for natural light, plus a portable cold plunge, delivered and set up at homes, gyms, and events. Hosts Micah and Austin handle towels, teas, and timing. Rated 5.0 across 7 reviews.

listings.name: Denver Sports Recovery
listings.description: Primarily a sports-recovery clinic — chiropractic, dry needling, massage — that adds a dry sauna and cold plunge for contrast work. One caveat surfaces repeatedly: reviewers flag an odor problem in the sauna. Rated 4.9 across 383 reviews.

listings.name: Denver Zen Den
listings.description: Private sauna and cold plunge sessions in Jefferson Park, booked for individuals, couples, or small groups. The wildcard offering is the Lucia No°3 stroboscopic light experience, which guests describe as a sober psychedelic journey. Rated 5.0 across 48 reviews.

listings.name: Downtown Denver YMCA
listings.description: Membership or a day pass covers the traditional sauna and steam room at the downtown Y. Reviews are warmest about the classes and community services; membership-discount fine print is the common gripe. Rated 3.8 across 141 reviews.

listings.name: Dryden
listings.description: A Golden Triangle residential tower whose amenity floor includes a sauna, cold plunge, steam room, and a 19th-floor rooftop pool with city views. Residents love the setup but report intermittent closures of the thermal amenities. For tenants, not the public.

listings.name: Elixir Mind Body Massage
listings.description: The standard move at this massage studio: a 3-in-1 infrared sauna session before your table time, with the option to finish in the Polar Blaze cold plunge. A monthly massage subscription keeps regulars coming back. Rated 4.8 across 372 reviews.

location.address: 1518 Wazee St Suite A, Denver, Colorado, 80202

listings.name: Fit House Denver
listings.description: A group-fitness gym whose recovery corner — infrared sauna plus a cold plunge held at 38-39°F — gets used as seriously as the barbells. Members praise the transparent pricing and zero cancellation drama. Perfect 5.0 across 133 reviews.

listings.name: FoundryLine
listings.description: A RiNo apartment building whose residents' gym includes a traditional sauna and steam room, described by tenants as a genuinely luxurious touch. The rooftop pool, A Line access, and dog run round out the package. Residential access only.

listings.name: Garden Sauna Denver
listings.description: A single wood-fired barrel sauna in a backyard-style garden setting, paired with very cold garden tub plunges. The sauna interior is deliberately unlit — atmospheric by day, pitch black after dark. Owner Collin built the space himself and it shows. Rated 4.8 across 34 reviews.

listings.name: House of Motion Chiropractic
listings.description: Patients at Dr. Joe Chambers' chiropractic office top off adjustments with the infrared sauna and cold plunge. Care plans extend into curated exercises and mobility work — and the office dog, Keiba, gets his own mentions. Rated 5.0 across 84 reviews.

listings.name: Icelandic Fitness and Recovery
listings.description: Infrared saunas share the floor with hyperbaric oxygen chambers — a rare combination that members use for post-surgery and injury recovery. Owner Jason Stone is known for checking in mid-session, and reviewers call the pricing the best in Denver for these modalities. Rated 5.0 across 77 reviews.

location.address: 600 S Holly St Unit 104, Denver, Colorado, 80246

listings.name: JCC Fitness & Aquatics Center
listings.description: Inside the men's locker room: a dry sauna, steam room, and hot tub — when they're working, which members say isn't always. The renovated marble locker rooms and indoor-outdoor pools soften the blow, and day passes run $35. Rated 4.4 across 88 reviews.

listings.name: Juliana Duran | Brazilian Lymphatic Drainage Massage
listings.description: Sessions at this Cherry Creek studio start in a hot infrared sauna to loosen up before Juliana's Brazilian lymphatic drainage work — a technique reviewers insist she's mastered. Expect Aesop products, complimentary tea, and free garage parking. Rated 4.9 across 36 reviews.

listings.name: Lake Steam
listings.description: Denver's old-school Russian bathhouse: a multi-level cedar dry sauna, a eucalyptus-infused Turkish steam room, and separate men's and women's days. The $30 day pass is widely called the best shvitz deal in town, and the massages are priced lower than anywhere nearby. Rated 4.5 across 547 reviews.

listings.name: Lions Den Strength Mobility Performance
listings.description: A strength-and-mobility gym whose recovery room — traditional sauna plus an ice bath available essentially anytime — comes with the Base Plus membership tier. A dual membership with the adjacent Fusion Combat Training Center knocks 20% off each. Rated 5.0 across 70 reviews.

location.address: 5058 S Syracuse St Unit 10, Denver, Colorado, 80237

listings.name: LoHi Athletic Club
listings.description: A 24-hour neighborhood gym in the Highlands where the traditional sauna is a monthly add-on rather than an included perk — members still call it reasonably priced. Uncrowded compared to the chains, with a social regulars' scene. Rated 4.5 across 101 reviews.

listings.name: Martin Luther King Jr. Recreation Center
listings.description: Park Hill's rec center pairs a traditional dry sauna with a genuinely loved warm therapy pool — two depths, grab bars, kept very warm. Access runs through the city recreation membership, making this one of Denver's most affordable heat options. Rated 4.5 across 267 reviews.

listings.name: NAOSU SAUNA
listings.description: A three-level wooden sauna held at 185°F and up, flanked by five cold plunge tubs — three indoor, two outdoor barrels around 60°F. Sessions end with a tea service on the patio, and owner Jerry is often the one giving the tour. Rated 4.9 across 58 reviews.

listings.name: Nurture • The Wellcare Marketplace
listings.description: Part wellness marketplace, part coworking space, part café — with a Portal sauna that hits 210°F and a cold plunge that a loyal crew of regulars treats as a daily ritual. Fast WiFi and mostly gluten-free café food make it easy to stay for hours. Rated 4.3 across 107 reviews.

listings.name: Oakwell Beer Spa Denver
listings.description: Nowhere else in Denver runs this sequence: private infrared sauna, cold shower, then a beer-infused bath — with a self-pour wall of local craft beer in your room. Ninety-minute sessions are the popular pick, and it's a fixture for date nights. Rated 4.9 across 2,795 reviews.

listings.name: Ohana Yoga + Barre
listings.description: A Berkeley yoga and barre studio that happens to run a serious contrast setup: a Morozko Forge plunge at 37°F paired with an infrared sauna. Classes come first here — the recovery circuit is how members finish. Rated 4.9 across 147 reviews.

listings.name: Palm Beach Tan
listings.description: Upper membership tiers at this Baker-neighborhood tanning salon include Clearlight infrared sauna sessions. Staff get named in reviews for walking first-timers through the options without upsell pressure. Rated 4.6 across 550 reviews.

listings.name: PORTAL° Thermaculture
listings.description: Wood-fired saunas pushing 230°F, cold plunges that actually stay cold, and a West Highland patio scene that regulars treat as a second living room. There's a Boulder sibling location, and a popular coffee shop right next door. Rated 4.9 across 198 reviews.

listings.name: Pranava Massage
listings.description: Practitioner Landon's intuitive bodywork — including a synchronized four-hands option — is the draw at this RiNo studio, with a Canadian hemlock FAR infrared sauna available alongside. The art-filled space gets as much praise as the table work. Rated 5.0 across 189 reviews.

listings.name: Radiance Functional Medicine
listings.description: A membership-based functional medicine practice in Virginia Village where infrared sauna sessions support Dr. Tracy's treatment plans — hormone, thyroid, and gut health, with a perimenopause specialty. This is a clinical setting, not a drop-in sauna. Rated 5.0 across 18 reviews.

location.address: 1805 S Bellaire St Suite 310, Denver, Colorado, 80222

listings.name: Recovery Lounge & Spa
listings.description: Sunlighten 3-in-1 full-spectrum sauna sessions anchor treatment plans here that might also include PEMF, neurofeedback, craniosacral therapy, or lymphatic massage. Practitioners are praised by name for personalized care. Rated 4.9 across 91 reviews.

listings.name: Red Rocks Spa
listings.description: Private sauna suites for you or your party, plus a shared steam room and cold plunge for contrast rounds — all inside a woman-owned, family-run spa. Occasional reviews mention a murky plunge, so check the room before you commit. Rated 4.6 across 138 reviews.

location.address: 1842 S Parker Rd Unit 21, Denver, Colorado, 80231

listings.name: Reset Mind & Body - Denver (LoHi)
listings.description: A guided recovery circuit in LoHi: staff coach you through infrared sauna, stainless-steel cold plunge, compression boots, hot tub, and red light in a logical flow with no waiting. Guests report better sleep as the standout benefit. Rated 5.0 across 64 reviews.

listings.name: RÖK SPAS
listings.description: Steps from Union Station, RÖK claims the largest, hottest sauna in Colorado — Finnish radiant heat in a massive multi-level room — with cold plunges held at 48°F and a steam room on the circuit. No-shoes policy, memberships available. Rated 4.9 across 174 reviews.

listings.name: Sapa Spa and Wellness
listings.description: Solo or couples infrared sauna sessions at a gentle 115-135°F, plus something you won't find elsewhere in the U.S.: a Red Dao herbal bath served in copper tubs. Ginseng tea and a salt room complete the visit. Rated 5.0 across 66 reviews.

listings.name: Sesen Skin Body Wellness
listings.description: Facials, dermaplaning, sugaring, and Moxi laser come first at this skincare studio; the infrared sauna works as the detox add-on. Aestheticians are named in review after review, and the Hershey's kisses at the front desk get their own shout-outs. Rated 4.9 across 318 reviews.

listings.name: Studio CLMBR
listings.description: Disco ball, loud music, milestone boards — and a traditional sauna in the recovery room alongside compression boots and a Theragun. This climbing-machine studio charges $30 for drop-in classes. Rated 4.8 across 98 reviews.

listings.name: Summit Strong
listings.description: A free-weights-focused gym whose recovery room bundles an infrared sauna, steam room, cold plunge pool, and NormaTec sleeves — though some membership tiers pay extra for access, and day-pass visitors get in too. Classes are included in membership. Rated 4.4 across 210 reviews.

listings.name: Sway Wellness Spa Larimer
listings.description: The Remedy Room runs a tidy protocol — 20 minutes of sauna, 5 minutes of cold plunge — with compression boots and red light on the same circuit. Massages and facials fill out the menu, and members swear by the lounge. Rated 4.9 across 66 reviews.

listings.name: SweatHouz South Broadway Contrast Therapy Studio
listings.description: Private contrast-therapy suites on South Broadway run about 45 minutes in the infrared sauna, a vitamin-C shower, then the cold plunge — with a TV and streaming in every room. First sessions cost $40; note the $25 guest fee for a partner. Rated 5.0 across 106 reviews.

listings.name: Symmetry 360 Massage Highlands
listings.description: A Highlands massage studio where the 20-minute far-infrared-sauna-then-cold-plunge protocol has its own following. Monthly memberships make the routine affordable, and the therapist bench runs deep — six practitioners get named in reviews. Rated 4.9 across 1,116 reviews.

listings.name: THE Athletic Club
listings.description: A serious lifters' gym downtown with saunas in each locker room, hydro massage beds, and red light therapy forming the recovery circuit. Big windows, downtown views, and a weight-floor culture members describe as motivating rather than intimidating. Rated 4.9 across 326 reviews.

listings.name: The Cove Sauna and Cold Plunge
listings.description: Half sauna showroom in spirit, half recovery gym: a vibrational resonance sauna that plays your music through the bench, a salt halotherapy sauna, infrared and red light units, plus plunges at 40°F and 50°F. Owner Charlie walks newcomers through the whole circuit. Rated 5.0 across 56 reviews.

listings.name: The Helix Shop
listings.description: Not a bathhouse but a retailer: The Helix Shop sells traditional wood-fired and infrared saunas — with heaters from HUUM, Harvia, and Saunum — plus one- and two-person cold plunge tubs starting at $2,690. The Denver showroom is the place to compare equipment before buying.

listings.name: The Paramount
listings.description: A residential complex whose listed sauna is consistently reported broken and whose steam room draws cleanliness complaints. Between that and broader maintenance issues across the building, don't plan around the wellness amenities here. Rated 3.1 across 101 reviews.

listings.name: The Ritz-Carlton Spa, Denver
listings.description: The hotel spa's steam sauna and whirlpool are the pre- and post-treatment perks, open to treatment guests from 9 to 7 — locals can ask about the 10% weekday discount. There's no cold plunge, a gap reviewers specifically mention. Rated 4.3 across 51 reviews.

listings.name: The Town Center Collection
listings.description: Residents at this Central Park-area complex say the advertised sauna and jacuzzi spend long stretches out of service; the Olympic-size pool is the social hub when things are working. Rated 2.8 across 347 reviews — read recent resident feedback carefully.

listings.name: Traverse Fitness
listings.description: A custom cedar sauna and precision cold plunge anchor the recovery space at this ego-free training gym, which also runs a coworking area and free coffee. Coaches know members by name, and the community organizes events beyond the workouts. Rated 5.0 across 104 reviews.

listings.name: Upswell RiNo Station
listings.description: RiNo's active-recovery studio built around a 160-180°F traditional sauna and an in-ground cold plunge pool at about 55°F — big enough for a whole team to plunge at once. Compression units and PEMF mats fill out the recovery area. Rated 4.8 across 8 reviews.

listings.name: Upswell Studio South Broadway
listings.description: The South Broadway sibling goes pod-based: single or two-person infrared sauna capsules with chromotherapy, a 40-45°F plunge, and a warm 98-104°F soak for the full circuit. Yoga classes and NormaTec compression round out the membership. Rated 4.9 across 62 reviews.

listings.name: Urban Sweat Cherry Creek
listings.description: Both traditional and infrared saunas are on the menu at this Cherry Creek recovery studio, with tandem rooms for pairs. The popular 'triple combo' strings together lymphatic roller massage, sauna, and red light therapy. Rated 4.6 across 46 reviews.

listings.name: VASA Fitness
listings.description: A high-volume budget gym where the traditional sauna and heated Studio Red yoga classes come with a cheap membership — the trade-off is crowds at nearly all hours. Childcare and strong group-fitness instructors keep the rating at 4.0 across 2,563 reviews.

listings.name: 24 Hour Fitness
listings.description: Members consistently call out the sauna and steam room as the bonus that makes this big-box membership worth it, alongside a lap pool, turf zones, and a huge strength floor. The atmosphere gets praised as genuinely non-intimidating for beginners. Rated 4.5 across 2,123 reviews.

listings.name: ActIVate Drip Spa | Memorial
listings.description: IV hydration is the main event at this Memorial med-spa — drips like The Hulk for energy, plus boosters, facials, and body contouring — with infrared sauna sessions on the wellness menu. Dr. Tasha Roberts' team keeps most appointments under an hour. Rated 4.9 across 116 reviews.

location.address: 7925 Katy Fwy suite i, Houston, Texas, 77024

listings.name: Activate Ozone Sauna Spa
listings.description: The specialty here is ozone sauna therapy, often paired with EWOT (exercise with oxygen) — guests report leaving clear-headed and noticeably energized. Owner Gabriela stays in the room with first-timers and builds multi-session plans, which come with package discounts. Rated 5.0 across 58 reviews.

listings.name: ALBI Wellness
listings.description: An infrared sauna shares this modern recovery suite with Flowpresso lymphatic compression, hyperbaric oxygen, PEMF, and sound-healing beds. Owner Tarek and team walk guests through the options, and the space hosts community events like sound baths. Rated 5.0 across 127 reviews.

location.address: 2202 W Alabama St c, Houston, Texas, 77098

listings.name: beem Light Sauna River Oaks
listings.description: Private full-spectrum infrared suites with adjustable temperature, chromotherapy lighting, and an in-room iPad, finished with a cold mint towel. A social sauna room handles pairs and small groups. Red light therapy is the common add-on. Rated 5.0 across 104 reviews.

location.address: 2800 Kirby Dr suite b 116, Houston, Texas, 77098

listings.name: beem® Light Sauna Energy Corridor
listings.description: The Energy Corridor outpost of the beem franchise runs 40-minute full-spectrum infrared sessions in private suites, with near, mid, and far wavelengths and red light therapy available. listings.name: Framework, East Nashville Backyard
listings.description: Cold Plunge & SaunaThis studio offers a dedicated contrast therapy experience centered on a best-in-class traditional sauna and multiple cold plunge tubs. The core routine involves moving from a super-hot traditional sauna directly into one of four cold plunge tubs, each set at a different temperature. listings.name: Framework, Wedgewood Houston Flagship
listings.description: Cold Plunge & SaunaFramework's Wedgewood Houston Flagship is Nashville's first dedicated social studio for sauna and cold plunge, offering a comprehensive contrast therapy experience. The studio provides seven traditional saunas and thirteen cold plunge tubs, available in both indoor and outdoor, public and private configurations. Members follow a recommended cycle of a quick rinse, a "shiver" in a cold plunge, and a "sweat" in a sauna, repeating as desired. The cold plunges offer a choice of three distinct temperatures: 60, 50, and 40 degrees Fahrenheit, allowing guests to challenge themselves. A typical session lasts a full hour, with guests moving back and forth between the saunas and cold plunges. This contrast therapy is noted for its rejuvenating and recovery benefits, with many members reporting feeling exceptionally good afterward and considering it a life-changing addition to their wellness routine.AtmosphereThe facility is described as gorgeous, clean, modern, and spotless, with a great peaceful feeling inside. It provides a versatile environment where guests can engage in the social community aspect, meeting and chatting with others, or opt for a more quiet and relaxing experience. The space has an inspiring energy, making it suitable for both personal wellness sessions and hosted events. The overall atmosphere is distinct from typical gym saunas, noted for being hygienic and tranquil.StaffThe staff are consistently highlighted as extremely friendly, welcoming, and genuinely committed to ensuring a great experience. Specific team members like Steven, who provides tours and coaching for the cold plunge, and the Sunday crew Bekah & MK, are mentioned by name for their attentive service. The owner, Allen, is noted as being beyond accommodating and supportive for events.Additional AmenitiesThe studio features an upstairs cafe where guests can enjoy beverages and snacks, such as protein donuts, after their session. The venue also serves as a versatile event space, praised for hosting gatherings like wellness events and creative activations successfully.Location & ExpansionThe studio is located in the Wedgewood Houston neighborhood of Nashville and offers a free parking lot, which guests find convenient. There is no mention of expansion plans in the provided reviews.

listings.name: Holiday Salon & Bathhouse
listings.description: This Finnish-inspired bathhouse and spa, located in a rehabilitated 100-year-old factory space in East Nashville, offers a premier sauna and cold plunge experience. Spa-goers highlight the Soak & Sauna room, which features a large 104°F salt water soaking pool, a Himalayan salt sauna, and a steam room. The cold plunge shower provides a refreshing contrast, allowing guests to engage in contrast therapy. The sauna facilities are consistently described as clean, well-maintained, and contributing to a peaceful, relaxing atmosphere. Guests leave feeling refreshed and rejuvenated from these thermal amenities.Beyond the bathhouse, Holiday Salon & Bathhouse provides a full suite of salon and spa services, including custom facials, hair services, massage, and hair removal. The minimalist design is filled with natural light, creating a soothing ambiance. The venue is noted for its ample group options, accommodating parties from 2 to 10 people for a relaxing retreat. The locker rooms are well-equipped, providing towels, basic toiletries, and showers. An attached retail space sells high-end products. While some guests note a higher price point for certain services, many find the overall experience to be a luxurious and exceptional treat, perfect for special occasions or a break from daily life.

listings.name: HOTWORX - Nashville, TN - Midtown
listings.description: This 24-hour infrared fitness studio provides gym members with access to private infrared sauna rooms for virtually instructed workouts. The core experience centers on the hot infrared sauna, where members can complete efficient 15-minute High-Intensity Interval Training or 30-minute isometric sessions like Hot Yoga, Hot Pilates, and Hot Core. The infrared heat is noted for facilitating a good, intense workout in a short amount of time. However, gym members report significant inconsistency in the cleanliness and maintenance of these sauna facilities. Multiple members describe finding the saunas in a state of neglect, citing issues like dust, scum, and broken controls, though the units remain functional. The condition of the saunas is a primary concern for many visitors, with some noting a noticeable difference in upkeep compared to other locations.Beyond the sauna workouts, the gym offers a free weights section and a Functional Exercise area. The overall ambiance is described as great and the space is tucked away in Midtown. Staff receive mixed feedback, with some members finding them super friendly and welcoming, while others cite issues with policy communication. The total body trainer is highlighted as an effective workout option. The membership includes a clear cancellation policy that involves a fee, which some members find disappointing and unclear regarding pause options. This venue appeals to those seeking an efficient, infrared-heat-based workout in a smaller studio environment.

listings.name: iCRYO CRYOTHERAPY + iV THERAPY + BODY SCULPTING + RED LIGHT THERAPY

Guests enjoy the ability to combine multiple services, such as compression, cryo, red light, and sauna, in a single visit to address their wellness needs.

listings.name: LaSculpt BodySculpting Spa

listings.name: Lolu
listings.description: Lolu provides a traditional Western red cedar sauna and a dedicated cold plunge for contrast therapy in Nashville. Spa-goers also appreciate complimentary tea, free parking, and fair walk-in pricing. The overall experience leaves visitors feeling rejuvenated, relaxed, and connected, having challenged both mind and body in a luxurious yet minimal environment.

listings.name: Next Health in The Gulch - Nashville

The spa provides a holistic wellness experience with a focus on float therapy, infrared sauna, PEMF mat, and air compression massage to help guests recharge. Spa-goers describe the float therapy as a relaxing and transformative experience, with many noting immediate decreases in stress levels after a session. Some guests, however, have noted that the float tank water can feel chilly when entering or exiting, and a few have mentioned that the pods were not completely dark or quiet, with light visible under the door.AtmosphereThe spa features clean, calming spaces designed for deep rest and rejuvenation. Guests consistently highlight the clean and comfortable environment, describing it as very zen and peaceful. The overall atmosphere is noted for being conducive to relaxation and shutting off the mind.PricingGuests find the pricing to be very affordable. The spa offers a monthly program, and some guests have mentioned interest in trying other services. There is also mention of occasional BOGO deals that guests wish they had utilized.StaffStaff members like Will, Jordan, and Alex are noted by name for being super helpful, knowledgeable, and for making guests feel comfortable. They are described as informative without being overwhelming, walking guests through the process and answering all questions. However, there is mixed feedback, with one guest reporting that staff did not adequately address concerns about their experience.Additional AmenitiesIn addition to float therapy and infrared sauna, the spa provides a PEMF mat and air compression massage. The facility includes private shower areas, though one guest reported an issue with no hot water or body wash available during their visit.

listings.name: Heim Regenerative Medicine Center
listings.description: Heim Regenerative Medicine Center offers a premier guided sauna and cold plunge experience, known as Frequency Fridays at Fire and Frost. Guests highlight the cedar-scented sauna and the top-notch, self-cleaning cold plunge pools, which feature clean, filtered, and structured water without harsh chemicals. The contrast therapy sessions are led by knowledgeable facilitators like Keith Kemp and Ashley, who provide careful guidance on safely maximizing the benefits. This practice allows guests to reset their minds, honor their bodies, and comfortably extend their time in the cold plunge. The outdoor space is described as gorgeous, and the spotless facilities include clean bathrooms, changing rooms, and lockers.Beyond the thermal offerings, the center provides a comprehensive range of advanced wellness treatments under the direction of Dr. Michael Heim. With over 25 years of experience, Dr. Heim and his team specialize in Regenerative and Anti-Aging Therapy, including Stem Cell treatments, Exosome Therapy, Hormone Optimization, and IV Therapy. Additional services such as Cryotherapy and Compression Therapy are also available. Guests consistently praise the staff for being friendly, knowledgeable, and attentive, creating a warm and welcoming atmosphere. The venue has cultivated a strong sense of community, making it a hub for healing, health, and personalized care where wellness and connection come together naturally.

listings.name: Kodawari Studios
listings.description: Kodawari Studios offers a signature contrast therapy experience centered on its restorative sauna and cold plunge. Members participate in instructor-led sauna sessions that follow the Kodawari protocol, consisting of three invigorating rounds of heat and cold. Guests describe these sessions as grounding, invigorating, and game-changing for training and recovery. The sauna guides are noted as incredible, energetic, and inspiring, contributing significantly to the quality of the experience. Many members make the sauna and cold plunge a deliberate follow-up to their yoga classes, highlighting the integrated approach to wellness. The studio provides a dedicated Friday group session for this therapy, which is praised for its friendly atmosphere.Beyond contrast therapy, this South Tampa studio is a comprehensive wellness destination. It offers an extensive variety of yoga classes, including hot yoga, hot power, yin, and sessions incorporating sound bowls and yoga nidra for deep relaxation. The studio complements its physical practices with holistic services like massage therapy, acupuncture, chiropractic care, and breathwork sessions. Members frequently highlight the amazing value of the unlimited yoga and sauna membership, the flexible daily scheduling, and the exceptionally welcoming and supportive community. The staff, from instructors and sauna leads to the front desk and the involved owner, consistently make guests feel at home. The venue also features an on-site shop and a convenient location.

listings.name: Perspire Sauna Studio
listings.description: Cold Plunge & SaunaThis studio offers private, personalized suites featuring full-spectrum infrared saunas that combine traditional heat therapy with modern technology. Members particularly appreciate the adjustable sauna temperature, which allows for a customized experience to fit individual needs and tolerance levels, such as for those with specific health considerations. The studio provides a dry sauna experience that can be combined with red light therapy during the session. For contrast therapy, a unique "snow shower" provides a cold plunge experience without requiring full submersion. Members love the ability to have a dry sauna and red light therapy session and then use the cold plunge shower. The sauna rooms are noted for being beautiful, clean, and relaxing, with guests reporting feeling amazing and refreshed after each session. Chromotherapy customization adds another layer to the personalized wellness experience.AtmosphereThe studio provides a luxurious, 5-star hotel ambiance. Members describe the environment as a personal slice of heaven, offering a serene and relaxing space for detox and personal "me" time. The private suites enhance the feeling of privacy and tranquility. Each suite is equipped with a TV displaying relaxing nature views, preventing the experience of simply staring at a wall, which members feel demonstrates a strong focus on guest experience.PricingMembership packages are available and are described as fairly priced. The online booking system is noted for being convenient and user-friendly, allowing members to easily schedule sessions, such as after leaving the gym.StaffThe staff is consistently described as kind, friendly, helpful, and accommodating. Specific team members, like Amy, are highlighted for making guests feel like part of the family. The team ensures rooms are ready and set to each member's specific desired temperature and settings upon arrival.Additional AmenitiesKey additional amenities include the integration of red light therapy within the sauna session and chromotherapy lighting for customization. These features contribute to the reported benefits members see in their skin and feel in their bodies.

listings.name: Restore Hyper Wellness
listings.description: Cold Plunge & SaunaThis venue offers an infrared sauna, which is a key component of many guests' personal wellness and recovery routines. Guests specifically visit for this science-backed thermal therapy, reporting it as an effective tool for detoxification and physical relief. Many note it makes them feel better physically, with one guest incorporating it into a Lyme disease treatment protocol to help the body detox. The sauna experience is supported by a clean and modern facility.StaffThe staff receives consistent praise for being friendly, funny, super accommodating, and knowledgeable. Specific team members highlighted by name include Tyler, Maddie, Samantha, KaLee, Sam, Amanda, Kasey, Jodi, and Rachel. Guests describe the team as incredible, a delight, and highly attentive, noting they take time to discuss health recommendations and provide a warm welcome.Additional AmenitiesBeyond the sauna, Restore Hyper Wellness provides a broad suite of services focused on recovery and overall wellness. This includes IV drip therapy for hydration, nutrient infusion, and recovery from illness or sports, with a new IV menu noted. Other services mentioned are NAD therapy and Jan Marini facials. The nurses are noted for providing great suggestions based on lab results to help guests achieve their wellness goals.AtmosphereThe facility is described as modern, clean, comfortable, and inviting.
