listings.name: Shangri-La Bath & Sauna
listings.description: Cold Plunge & SaunaThis authentic Korean spa offers a comprehensive thermal wellness experience centered on its clay and salt saunas. Spa-goers note these saunas are spotlessly clean but kept quite hot, making extended sessions challenging; the spa provides boards for resting. The wet area features a steam room, a hot tub soaking pool, and a cold dip pool specifically recommended for contrast therapy. Guests often describe alternating between the steam, hot tub, and cold plunge as part of their ritual. Both the hot tub and cold plunge pools are noted to be fairly small. The facility requires guests to be fully nude in this wet area, and no phones are permitted.AtmosphereThe spa provides a relaxing atmosphere where guests can unwind for several hours with no time limit on their stay. The common area and sauna spaces are described as spotless. The environment is noted to be more serene on weekdays with fewer visitors.PricingAdmission is very affordable, with a day pass costing $33-$35 per adult for full access to all wet area amenities and saunas. There is no limit to how long guests can stay. Additional services like body scrubs, massages, and facials are available at extra cost.StaffFeedback on staff is mixed, with many guests praising specific team members like John, Kate, and the owner for being friendly, professional, and welcoming. They are noted for thoroughly explaining the experience and performing excellent services. However, some guests report instances of dismissive or rude treatment from front desk personnel.Additional AmenitiesA key additional amenity is the on-site restaurant located in the common area. It serves a delicious, made-to-order Korean menu with a good selection, including full vegetarian options. Guests are permitted to bring their own food, but it must be left at the front desk with no glass or alcohol.

listings.name: SOHO Wellness & Med Spa | Tampa
listings.description: Spa-goers at SOHO Wellness & Med Spa begin their experience with the facility's infrared sauna, noting a relaxing and cozy session. Guests appreciate the clean sauna facilities and the comfortable robes and slippers provided, with many enjoying the view from within the sauna. This initial wellness offering sets the tone for a visit dedicated to self-preservation through personalized treatments for the body and skin. The spa provides a wide range of services beyond the sauna, including facials, massage therapy, Botox, dermal fillers, and PDO thread lifts.The serene, state-of-the-art facility maintains a clean, calm, and comfortable atmosphere perfect for unwinding. Guests consistently praise the friendly, knowledgeable, and intentional staff, from the helpful front desk to the skilled therapists and estheticians. Many highlight effective massage treatments, including deep tissue with hot stones and couples massages, as well as rejuvenating facials that leave skin feeling refined. The spa also offers thoughtful amenities, such as a lounge with a variety of beverage and snack options, lockers for personal belongings, and special touches like new client specials and birthday gifts. This combination of advanced cosmetic treatments, therapeutic relaxation, and a welcoming environment makes SOHO Wellness & Med Spa a premier destination for rejuvenation in Tampa.

listings.name: The Body Lab

This recovery-focused regimen utilizes hot-cold cycles as a key component of the therapeutic journey. Guests who have incorporated contrast therapy into their post-operative care report leaving feeling 100% better and able to move around freely, highlighting its significant role in their recovery. The venue provides this multi-faceted wellness experience with contrast therapy as a central offering.StaffThe venue is noted for its top-notch crew of skilled massage therapists. Specific practitioners like Shay, Gavi, Jason, and Lilly receive high praise from guests. Shay creates a calm and welcoming atmosphere with a professional and kind demeanor, taking time to listen to specific concerns. Gavi is highlighted for her expertise in post-operative massage and lymphatic drainage, attentively adjusting techniques to cater to ongoing recovery needs. Jason is noted for his impeccable energy and effective therapeutic work, while Lilly provided an amazing fire cupping session. Guests describe these therapists as incredibly skilled, compassionate, and passionate about their work.AtmosphereThe spa provides a soothing atmosphere with calming music and the perfect ambiance to help guests relax. Therapists like Shay are noted for creating a calm and welcoming environment. Guests describe leaving sessions with a profound sense of relaxation and feeling completely rejuvenated and in their environment after treatments.Additional AmenitiesBeyond contrast therapy, The Body Lab offers a range of specialized bodywork services. These include lymphatic drainage massage, traditional cupping therapy, and fire cupping sessions. These services are reported to be effective for pain relief, reducing swelling, working through tension, and promoting a sense of rejuvenation.

listings.name: Triarii Fitness
listings.description: Triarii Fitness offers a dry sauna, which gym members frequently highlight as a favorite amenity and a huge plus for recovery. The facility provides this sauna as a key part of its wellness services, complementing its core fitness offerings. This gym is Tampa’s premier destination for private personal training, massage therapy, and recovery, conveniently located in Town 'n' Country and serving clients across South Tampa, Westchase, Carrollwood, and Citrus Park. The certified personal trainers, including Justin and Clarissa, are noted for being incredibly knowledgeable, patient, and attentive to foundations. They provide highly personalized, one-on-one sessions tailored to individual goals, with a focus on functional mobility and strength training while ensuring safety. Members consistently praise the facility for being super clean, well-equipped with new equipment, and having a great, welcoming atmosphere with motivating music. The gym also has licensed massage therapists, like Heather, on staff, allowing guests to access both training and therapeutic massage in one private location. While some members note the pricing is not cheap, many express feeling they get more than they pay for, citing significant improvements in strength, flexibility, range of motion, and overall fitness results.

listings.name: Tummo Studios Tampa
listings.description: Cold Plunge & SaunaTummo Studios Tampa offers a sauna and cold plunge package as an add-on to its signature EMS workouts. This contrast therapy amenity is positioned as a key recovery tool. Gym members who utilize this package report a significant reduction in post-workout muscle soreness, with one member noting the complete elimination of the "burn" after working out. Another member confirmed that adding the cold plunge/sauna package resulted in no burn after exercising, highlighting its effectiveness for recovery.StaffThe gym's staff receives consistent praise for being knowledgeable, friendly, and effective. Specific team members mentioned by name include Cat, Phill, Joe, Halle, and Kat. Members appreciate that coaches thoroughly explain the EMS system, carefully coach posture and range of motion, and provide patient guidance through the workout process.Additional AmenitiesThe primary amenity beyond the EMS training is the specialized recovery package featuring sauna and cold plunge contrast therapy. This is offered as an add-on to enhance the post-workout recovery experience for members seeking to reduce muscle soreness.

listings.name: Turtle shell UBR
listings.description: Turtle Shell UBR provides a dedicated recovery environment centered on effective contrast therapy. The spa features an excellent sauna described as soothing, which guests use for extended sessions, often for thirty minutes or more. For cold therapy, there are four cold plunge baths with multiple temperature options, allowing spa-goers to build their cold plunge capacity. The cold tubs are noted as spacious, accommodating two people, and are designed for athletes seeking to maximize performance and speed up recovery. Guests consistently highlight the perfect combination of sauna and ice baths for deeply restorative contrast therapy sessions that leave them feeling refreshed and recharged. The entire facility is maintained to a high standard of cleanliness, with showers available for use between sessions.Beyond the core thermal experiences, the spa offers additional wellness modalities. An infrared station is available for targeted therapy, and guests can utilize red light therapy, often for ten-minute sessions. The lounge and work area are comfortable and clean, contributing to the spa's peaceful and inspiring vibe. Heated robes add a luxurious touch to the experience. For refreshment, the spa provides pure reverse osmosis water and espresso drinks. Turtle Shell UBR also offers professional hair transformation services, with guests noting exceptional care and results. The knowledgeable and friendly staff, including the owners, are frequently praised for creating a welcoming atmosphere where every detail feels thoughtfully designed for guest wellness.
